headline: Harper's 9th-inning homer ties it, but Braves win in 10th
recap: The Phillies and Braves traded the lead deep into the night before Atlanta pulled it out in extra innings. Trailing 8-6 in the ninth, Bryce Harper hit a two-run homer off Raisel Iglesias to score Trea Turner and tie the game at 8-8. In the top of the 10th, Kevin Pillar singled home the automatic runner and Orlando Arcia doubled home Pillar off Jose Alvarado, and Kirby Yates retired the Phillies in order in the bottom half to close out a 10-8 Atlanta win.

Taijuan Walker started for Philadelphia and was tagged for six runs over 5.1 innings; Charlie Morton started for Atlanta and allowed four runs over six innings. Neither starter factored into the decision, which fell on Alvarado for the loss and Yates for the save out of the bullpens.

Four home runs accounted for most of the scoring before the 10th. Michael Harris II hit a two-run homer and Ronald Acuna Jr. followed with a solo shot in a three-run sixth that put Atlanta ahead 8-4. Trea Turner's two-run homer in the seventh cut the deficit to 8-6, and Harper's two-run shot in the ninth pulled the Phillies level before Atlanta's tenth-inning rally decided it.
